title: 温室效应与人类的连锁反应
topic: The greenhouse effect, climate change, and the chain of environmental damage

sentences.en: Today I want to walk you through one process that ties almost every environmental problem together: the greenhouse effect.
sentences.zh: 今天我想带大家理清一个把几乎所有环境问题都串在一起的过程：温室效应。

sentences.en: The name comes from an ordinary greenhouse, the glass building that lets sunlight in but traps the heat inside so plants stay warm.
sentences.zh: 这个名字来自普通的温室，也就是那种让阳光进来、却把热量困在里面、好让植物保暖的玻璃房。

sentences.en: Certain gases in our atmosphere do the same thing, and the most important one is carbon dioxide.
sentences.zh: 我们大气中的某些气体也在做同样的事，而其中最重要的一种就是二氧化碳。

sentences.en: Where does all that carbon come from? Mostly from burning fossil fuels, the coal and oil formed from remains buried for millions of years.
sentences.zh: 这么多碳是从哪来的呢？主要来自燃烧化石燃料，也就是由埋藏了数百万年的遗骸形成的煤和石油。

sentences.en: When a power plant burns coal, it emits carbon dioxide, and these emissions have risen sharply since the Industrial Revolution.
sentences.zh: 当一座电厂燃烧煤炭时，它会排放二氧化碳，而自工业革命以来这些排放量已经急剧上升。

sentences.en: Cutting forests makes the problem worse, because deforestation removes the very trees that would otherwise absorb that carbon.
sentences.zh: 砍伐森林让问题雪上加霜，因为森林砍伐移除的恰恰是本可以吸收这些碳的树木。

sentences.en: So the extra heat we trap has real consequences: longer periods of drought, and when a reservoir that supplies a city drops to record lows, water itself becomes a scarce resource.
sentences.zh: 所以我们困住的这些多余热量会带来实实在在的后果：更长的干旱期，而当一座供应城市用水的水库降到历史最低时，水本身就成了稀缺资源。

sentences.en: Warming also disrupts habitats; a species that loses its habitat may become endangered, and if the trend continues, that decline ends in extinction, chipping away at the region's biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 变暖还会破坏栖息地；一个失去栖息地的物种可能变成濒危，如果这种趋势持续下去，这种衰退最终会以灭绝告终，一点点削弱这个地区的生物多样性。

sentences.en: And once a species is extinct, it is gone for good; no conservation effort can bring it back.
sentences.zh: 而一个物种一旦灭绝，就永远消失了；再多的保护努力也无法让它复生。

sentences.en: A related atmospheric problem is the thinning of the ozone layer, the high-altitude shield that blocks harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.
sentences.zh: 一个相关的大气问题是臭氧层变薄——臭氧层是高空的一道屏障，能挡住来自太阳的有害紫外线。

sentences.en: Now, greenhouse warming is only one form of pressure; a healthy ecosystem is also threatened by ordinary pollution.
sentences.zh: 不过，温室变暖只是压力的一种形式；一个健康的生态系统同样受到普通污染的威胁。

sentences.en: A factory that dumps toxic chemicals or untreated sewage into a river will pollute the water and destroy the fish downstream.
sentences.zh: 一座把有毒化学品或未经处理的污水倒进河里的工厂，会污染河水，并毁掉下游的鱼类。

sentences.en: On farmland, a pesticide sprayed to kill insects can wash into the soil and contaminate the groundwater below.
sentences.zh: 在农田里，为杀虫而喷洒的农药会渗入土壤，污染下方的地下水。

sentences.en: Once such a pollutant spreads, the contamination is expensive and slow to reverse.
sentences.zh: 这样一种污染物一旦扩散开来，这种污染就既昂贵又缓慢，难以逆转。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, poor farming and the loss of tree roots speed up erosion, so the fertile topsoil simply washes away.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，粗放的耕作和树根的消失会加快侵蚀，于是肥沃的表层土就这么被冲走了。

sentences.en: All of this together is what scientists call environmental degradation: the land, water, and air steadily degrade in quality.
sentences.zh: 所有这些加在一起，就是科学家所说的环境退化：土地、水和空气的质量在稳步恶化。

sentences.en: The encouraging news is that we know how to slow it down, and the key word is sustainable: instead of fossil fuels, we can shift to renewable energy from the sun and wind, sources that never run out.
sentences.zh: 令人振奋的消息是，我们知道该如何减缓它，而关键词就是「可持续」：我们可以放弃化石燃料，转向来自太阳和风的可再生能源，这些能源永远不会枯竭。

sentences.en: We can conserve water and electricity, recycle paper and plastic instead of sending them to a landfill as waste, and treat sewage before it reaches the sea.
sentences.zh: 我们可以节约水和电，把纸张和塑料回收利用，而不是当作废物送进垃圾填埋场，并在污水入海之前先加以处理。

sentences.en: Conservation programs can preserve a forest or a wetland, protecting the habitat so its species can recover.
sentences.zh: 保护项目可以保护一片森林或湿地，守住栖息地，让那里的物种得以恢复。

sentences.en: None of these steps is dramatic on its own, but together they let human society sustain itself without wrecking the planet it depends on.
sentences.zh: 这些措施单独看都不惊天动地，但合在一起，就能让人类社会在不毁掉它所依赖的这颗星球的前提下维持下去。
